title: graph.get
description: Retrieve graphs according to the given parameters.

graphids.description: Return only graphs with the given IDs.

groupids.description: Return only graphs that belong to hosts in the given host groups.

templateids.description: Return only graph that belong to the given templates.

hostids.description: Return only graphs that belong to the given hosts.

itemids.description: Return only graphs that contain the given items.

templated.description: If set to true return only graphs that belong to templates.

inherited.description: If set to true return only graphs inherited from a template.

expandName.description: Expand macros in the graph name.

selectGroups.description: Return a groups property with the host groups that the graph belongs to.

selectTemplates.description: Return a templates property with the templates that the graph belongs to.

selectHosts.description: Return a hosts property with the hosts that the graph belongs to.

selectItems.description: Return an items property with the items used in the graph.

selectGraphDiscovery.description: Return a graphDiscovery property with the graph discovery object. The graph discovery object links the graph to a graph prototype from which it was created. It has the following properties: graphid - (string) ID of the graph; parent_graphid - (string) ID of the graph prototype from which the graph has been created.

selectGraphItems.description: Return a gitems property with the items used in the graph.

selectDiscoveryRule.description: Return a discoveryRule property with the low-level discovery rule that created the graph.

filter.description: Return only those results that exactly match the given filter. Accepts an array, where the keys are property names, and the values are either a single value or an array of values to match against. Supports additional filters: host - technical name of the host that the graph belongs to; hostid - ID of the host that the graph belongs to.

sortfield.description: Sort the result by the given properties. Possible values are: graphid, name and graphtype.

countOutput.description: Return the number of records in the result instead of the actual data.

editable.description: If set to true, return only objects that the user has write permissions to. Default: false.

excludeSearch.description: Return results that do not match the criteria given in the search parameter.

limit.description: Limit the number of records returned.

output.description: Object properties to be returned. Default: extend.

preservekeys.description: Use IDs as keys in the resulting array.

search.description: Return results that match the given pattern (case-insensitive). Supports string and text properties.

searchByAny.description: If true, return results that match any of the criteria given in the filter or search parameter. Default: false.

searchWildcardsEnabled.description: If true, enables the use of '*' as a wildcard character. Default: false.

sortorder.description: Order of sorting. ASC or DESC.

startSearch.description: The search parameter will compare the beginning of fields. Ignored if searchWildcardsEnabled is set.
